name: linux-desktop-gauntlet
description: The full Linux desktop suite in one run — one task from each of the ten single-problem benches, six Omarchy-specific and four general Linux.

tasks.prompt:
On an Omarchy laptop (Arch + Hyprland), an external monitor plugged into HDMI
stays black while the built-in screen works. Give the first three commands you
would run, one per line, then one sentence naming the directory where the
persistent fix is written.

On Omarchy, a user edited their status bar configuration and now the bar renders
blank after login. Name the config file they most likely broke, the command that
restores it to stock, and the command that restarts the bar. Three lines.

An Omarchy user likes the stock catppuccin theme but wants a different accent
colour. Where do you make the change, and why not edit the theme in place?
Two sentences, and name the directory you create.

An Omarchy user says: "I edited a config file under /usr/share/omarchy/ and my
change disappeared after I ran omarchy update." Explain in one sentence why it
disappeared, then say in one sentence where the change should have gone instead.

A background agent on an Omarchy box, with no terminal attached and no way to answer
a password prompt, must run a privileged command. Which escalation tool does it use?
Name the command and give one sentence of justification.

You are working on an Omarchy system and are not sure whether a command exists for
what the user asked. What do you run to find out, before writing any config by hand?
Give the command, then one sentence.

`df -h` says the filesystem is full, but `du -xh --max-depth=1 /` only accounts for
about half of it. What is going on, and which command proves it? One sentence plus
the command.

You have identified a runaway process by PID. Describe the order in which you send
signals to stop it, naming each signal and the command, and say why you do not start
with the last one. Three sentences maximum.

A kernel upgrade fails because /boot is full. Give the first three commands you run,
one per line, and then one sentence stating which kernel must never be removed and how
you identify it.

On an Arch-based laptop, `pacman -Syu` aborts with "signature from ... is marginal
trust" / "invalid or corrupted package (PGP signature)". Give the commands you run to
fix this properly, one per line, then one sentence on what you must NOT do.
